description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'GenericMapCollection' which provides a custom collection behavior backed by a Map. It offers standard collection methods with certain features and restrictions, such as unsupported add operations and custom iterator behavior.

classes.name: GenericMapCollection
classes.description: An abstract class implementing Collection, backed by a Map, providing collection operations with custom iteration.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Returns the underlying map source used by this collection.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over elements, with optional note access parameter for subclasses.

methods.name: containsAll
methods.description: Checks if all elements of a collection are contained.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the underlying source map is empty.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Removes all elements present in the specified collection.

methods.name: retainAll
methods.description: Retains only the elements present in the specified collection.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of entries in the source map.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns an array containing all of the elements.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns an array containing all of the elements, of specified type.

methods.name: appendTo
methods.description: Builds a string representation of the collection.

search-terms: abstract class collection backed by Map
